title: Maine Revised Statutes Title 14, Chapter 710 - Rental Property
verified_how: Fetched title14ch710sec0.html, which prints 'Title 14, Chapter 710: RENTAL PROPERTY' with live sections §6021 Implied warranty and covenant of habitability, §6021-A Treatment of bedbug infestation, §6022 Receipts for rent payments and security deposits, §6022-A Limit on initial amount paid by tenant, §6024 Heat and utilities in common areas, §6025 Access to premises, §6028 Penalties for late payment of rent, §6030 Unfair agreements, §6030-H Fees charged to applicants, §6030-I Optional recurring fee, §6030-J Total price disclosure statement, §6030-K Model residential lease (§6027 and §6029 shown REPEALED). Data extracted 10/20/2025; text current through October 1, 2025.
notes: Chapter 710 carries the substantive residential tenancy obligations. Eviction procedure, rent-increase notice and the rent-increase limitation are in the adjacent ch. 709 (Entry and Detainer, 14 M.R.S. §§6000-6017, also fetched and verified: §6015 Notice of rent or mandatory recurring fee increase, §6016 Rent increase limitation, §6014 Remedies for illegal evictions), and security-deposit handling is in ch. 710-A. General consumer protection is a separate statute, 5 M.R.S. ch. 10 (Unfair Trade Practices Act).
